verdict.rationale: Bitwarden documents its CLI as a fully-featured tool for managing the vault. The CLI supports personal-API-key auth for automated workflows, and its `bw serve` mode exposes a local Vault Management REST API. An official MCP server also completed a live handshake, so documented programmatic surfaces for agent vault management clearly exist. missing for 10: explicit evidence of create/edit item commands or endpoints, documented programmatic seeding of TOTP secrets on items, and hands-on confirmation of write operations through the MCP server or `bw serve`.
